scope: All tracked repository files plus non-ignored new deliverables. Pinned inputs and scratch are excluded. Documentation/evidence is included through docs/; artifacts/ mirrors are outside the Git candidate set.
existingGitObjectCoverage: Locally available objects in the promisor checkout; no history fetch or Git metadata write was performed. The full current-file snapshot was measured separately.
note: The actual final Git bundle is produced by submission tooling. The uncompressed payload estimate includes all locally available existing objects, new unique blobs and metadata allowances. The complete current-file gzip snapshot is also below the cap. Historical objects absent from this promisor checkout are not measured. Temporary archive lives outside the repository.
